auth.notes: If brandId supplied: needs canEdit, else 404 (not 403).

request.parse: `req.json().catch(() => ({}))` - malformed body behaves as {} -> 400 'b64 PDF data required'. JSON null body -> destructuring null throws TypeError -> 500.

fields.name: b64
fields.validation: non-string/empty -> 400 'b64 PDF data required'; decoded 0 or > 4 MiB -> 400 'Guidelines must be a PDF up to 4MB'; first 4 bytes != '%PDF' -> 400 'Guidelines must be a PDF'

fields.name: brandId
fields.validation: If the key is present with ANY value other than undefined (including null, "", numbers): resolved only when typeof string; caller must have canEdit, else 404 'Brand not found'. Checked AFTER the PDF checks.

checkOrder: 7. write PDF blob + pending job + trigger

body.error: Guidelines must be a PDF up to 4MB

errors.when: brandId present but not editable (incl. null/empty/non-UUID, read-only org member)

sideEffects: With brandId: PDF stored at brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/guidelines.pdf (kept); without: extract/<jobId>.pdf in store 'brand-assets', deleted by the background after extraction (brand-extract.ts:32-33; blobs.ts:80-82,123-125)
Job {status:'pending', userId} in store 'brand-extract-jobs' key extract/<jobId>.json (brand-extract.ts:34; blobs.ts:168-170)
Triggers brand-extract-background with {jobId, userId, pdfKey, ephemeral: !brand}; trigger failures swallowed (trigger.ts:3-25,43-49)

Background calls Anthropic (paid) with the whole PDF as a document block, model STORYLINE_MODEL (default claude-sonnet-4-6), max_tokens 2048, forced tool emit_brand_fields (brandExtract.ts:62-85; config.ts:33)
externalCalls: Anthropic Messages API from the background function (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) - paid
quirks: NO daily cap is enforced. loadCaps().brandExtractsPerUserPerDay (config.ts:23, default 10) and db.reserveBrandExtract / RPC reserve_brand_extract (db.ts:334-338; supabase/migrations/0005_brands.sql:28-62) exist, but nothing calls them (grep: only definitions). The plan's 'cap 10 per user per day' is not current behaviour.
brandId: null in JSON -> 404 (null !== undefined). The frontend omits it via JSON.stringify of undefined.
Malformed JSON -> 400 b64 message (catch -> {}), but literal `null` body -> 500.
PDF validation happens before the brand access check, so an invalid PDF to someone else's brand returns 400, not 404.
Trigger failure leaves job pending forever while 202 is returned.
beforeAnyState: Works without a brand (create-mode editor): PDF parked per job.

tests.asserts: 400 non-PDF and oversized; 404 unowned brandId; with brandId stores at guidelines key and triggers non-ephemeral job, 202; without brandId temp key + ephemeral; plus status + background tests

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1407-1436. Only 202 documented; errors undocumented; no mention of per-user cap (consistent with code) .

planSection65: Row: 'POST {b64, brandId} -> 202 {jobId} | Redis job; cap 10 per user per day'. INACCURATE: today there is no cap (reserve_brand_extract is never called). If the new service adds the cap it is a behaviour change (new 429 path) and must be decided explicitly. brandId is optional.
